entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it; the cargo is not yet with MSC.
The loaded container enters the container yard at the port of loading. After a move it reads as transit.
Moved out of one terminal of a transshipment port towards another.
The vessel's expected arrival at the port of discharge, a planned step.
Moved out of the terminal of discharge towards another yard.

entries.wording: Import Arrived at Destination Rail Ramp

entries.note: The loaded container waits at the terminal or rail ramp for the consignee's trucker to collect it.
The consignee's trucker takes the loaded container out of the terminal.
The consignee has unloaded the container and returned it empty. Before the container moved it is an unused one's return, and has no stage.

entries.wording: Empty received at origin rail ramp
entries.note: The empty container returned at a rail ramp after an inland delivery.
MSC closes the import once the consignee has the container, where it records no empty return, as for a lessor's container.
MSC releases the cargo to the consignee on paper, dated when it does so, even before the vessel arrives; the container may still be at sea.
The last day the consignee may leave the container at the terminal without charges, a deadline rather than a move.
